subject: POC hands-on session: room vs virtual, consent & load checks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: POC hands-on session: room vs virtual, consent & load checks

Hi Alex,

Great to be aligning on the hands-on portion of the POC. Per our call yesterday, we want to nail down: a) whether you want an onsite lab vs fully virtual workshop, b) a short prompt/route review window, and c) a 30–45 minute load sanity check at the end of day.

Quick asks so we can send a calendar invite and run the AV checklist:
- Preferred date and timezone (we suggested Oct 14 or 15 PDT)
- If onsite: attendee count + any guest badge/escort rules we should be aware of
- Recording: are you OK with session recording for internal playback? If not, we can take detailed notes only
- Any restricted screens (PHI/PII) we should avoid during the demo?

I'm attaching a short AV checklist and site access form we ask visitors to complete if you host onsite. CC'ing Hannah (ops lead) and Mina (technical PM) to coordinate the room and the load test windows.

If virtual works better, we'll publish a temporary test endpoint and reserve a 30-min slot for load verification at the end of the session.

Thanks — Ben

Attachments: site-access-form.pdf (PDF), av-checklist.xlsx (Excel), poc-agenda-v1.docx (Word)

--
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
https://redwood.ai

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC hands-on session: room vs virtual, consent & load checks

Ben — thanks for the summary and attachments. A couple of notes from our side:

- Dates: Oct 15 PDT would be better; Oct 14 conflicts with a board offsite.
- Onsite: We can host up to 8 people but our security team requires visitor badges and an escort for any external contractors. I can get the names 2 business days before.
- Recording: we prefer no recording and no transcripts captured for anything that contains patient examples or real PHI.
- Restricted screens: yes — anything with live patient identifiers is off-limits. We can prepare a sanitized dataset for the prompt review.

Would a virtual-first plan with the option to escalate onsite work if needed suit both teams? If so, can you send a run-of-show for the virtual flow and the load-test endpoint info?

Appreciate it — Alex
Lead Product Manager, ClearPath Health
alex.rivera@clearpathhealth.com | (617) 555-0210

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC hands-on session: room vs virtual, consent & load checks

Thanks Alex — copying scheduling updates to internal thread.

Ben/Mina, notes for ops:
- Booked tentative room "Lab B" for Oct 15 09:30–16:30 PDT (capacity 10). I'll hold the booking for 48 hours pending final headcount. If ClearPath confirms onsite, we must submit visitor badge names by Oct 13 EOD.
- Onsite flow: check-in at security desk -> escort to Lab B -> AV will be set to projector + screen share. We need to restrict recording at the console level; I will submit a request to our security team to disable meeting recording for that calendar event (they may require a textual waiver from ClearPath).
- Virtual-first plan: Recommended run-of-show (45–60m hands-on + 30m load sanity):
  09:30–10:15 Welcome + architecture & prompts walkthrough (screen share only; no participant recording)
  10:15–11:00 Hands-on prompt review (participants pair with our engineers; sanitized dataset)
  11:00–11:30 Load sanity (150–200 rps burst test against the test endpoint)
  11:30–12:00 Open Q&A and next steps

- Load testing: Mina — can you prepare a temporary key and a rate-limited endpoint for Oct 15? Target: sustained 100 rps for 5 minutes then 200 rps 1-minute bursts. Log retention for that session should be 7 days.

I'll draft a short consent blurb we ask external attendees to sign (no recordings, sanitized data only) and attach site-access-form to the invite if onsite.

Hannah
Director, Program Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC hands-on session: room vs virtual, consent & load checks

Alex — this plan works. We will proceed with Oct 15 PDT virtual-first and hold Lab B as backup. Action items for clarity: 

1) ClearPath: confirm onsite headcount by Tue Oct 13 EOD OR reply that you will remain virtual-only. Also confirm recording preference (we have a security waiver template if you agree to limited recording).
2) Mina: temporary key + test endpoint setup (see Hannah targets). Please add throttle rules to prevent accidental escalation.
3) Hannah: please attach the site-access-form only if Alex confirms onsite; otherwise, include the consent blurb for the virtual invite.

I'll send a calendar invite with both virtual dial-in and Lab B location. If we get the go-ahead for onsite, we'll swap in the badge form and the escort instructions.

Thanks all — Ben

On Tue, Oct 4, 2026 at 11:02 AM Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearpathhealth.com> wrote:
> Ben — one more item: we really prefer not to have recordings tied to our accounts. If Redwood needs a recording for internal debugging, can we limit capture to our sanitized session only?
> 
> Also, please include a short checklist we need to complete for visitor access. I can push names after I confirm with my security team.
> 
> — Alex

Best,
Alex
